goal: Finish the Google Chat bridge and test it end to end with live round-trip messages. Complete, land, and install the missing Rust agentctl chat runtime; launch the durable bridge/plugin host bound to the dev-hermit-014 coordinator; send Ryan a fresh Google Chat message; receive and process a live reply; send a confirming response; and preserve exact inbound ACK, pane-delivery, outbound receipt, process/socket, and restart-survival evidence. Do not declare the goal complete until that real round trip passes. Keep KVM, LiteInst, and mega-lander work isolated and do not take over their lanes.
